verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists '定时任务' (scheduled tasks) among its general assistant features. That is the product's own capability for tasks that run on a timer without user interaction, but the only evidence is a one-line category heading. Nothing documents how automations are configured, whether schedules recur, or how background runs execute and report results. The agentic coding docs describe interactive, conversation-driven work, not background automation. Missing for 10: documented setup of scheduled or recurring automations, confirmation of background execution and result delivery, triggers beyond a schedule, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
